mapper.select: SELECT id, icon, name, state, url, p_id, acl_value, grade, is_del FROM t_menu WHERE is_del = 0 ORDER BY grade, p_id, id
SELECT id, icon, name, state, url, p_id, acl_value, grade, is_del FROM t_menu WHERE name = #{name} AND is_del = 0
SELECT COUNT(1) FROM t_menu WHERE p_id = #{pId} AND is_del = 0

SELECT DISTINCT m.id, m.icon, m.name, m.state, m.url, m.p_id, m.acl_value, m.grade, m.is_del FROM t_menu m LEFT JOIN t_role_menu rm ON m.id = rm.menu_id LEFT JOIN t_user_role ur ON rm.role_id = ur.role_id WHERE m.is_del = 0 AND ur.user_id = #{userId} AND m.state = 0 ORDER BY m.grade, m.p_id, m.id
